intro.title: Point your camera at the photocard
intro.body: Turn on the camera and frame the front of the card. The one inside will pop out.

status.scanning: Frame the front of the card

mount.toUpright: Tap if the card is standing up
mount.toFlat: Tap if the card is lying flat

error.noCamera: This browser can't open the camera. Please try another browser.
error.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
error.unknown: Couldn't start AR. Please try again in a moment.

summon.hint: Drag to turn, pinch to resize
